decision_summary: Implement v0.6.27 as a narrow Evidence Origin traceability release.
rationale: Visionary: origin is the missing bridge from structural examples to empirical calibration. Builder: add one shared record shape in the four readiness package schemas, explicit record references on outcomes/cases, and deterministic CLI resolution. Guardian: examples must remain example origin; observed claims require verified provenance fields and must not be inferred from labels such as real-redacted or from activity counts.
recommendation: Proceed with schema, verifier, fixtures, examples, docs, and readiness changes only; defer suite health, variance, and learning records.
